target_customer: Operations, onboarding and enterprise automation teams that want undocumented work captured as playbooks and agents
problem: Knowledge about how teams really work lives in apps and heads and is never written down. GodHands observes work across apps and converts it into cited playbooks that people and agents can follow.
business_model: B2B enterprise software, pricing not public
product_category: AI process capture and workflow automation

founders.name: Sai Vamshi Batchu
founders.background_notes: Quantitative researcher at a high frequency trading firm per YC page.

founders.name: Aditya Bommakanti
founders.background_notes: Built low latency systems, research at UTokyo and Aarhus, NeurIPS publication per YC page.

competitors.traction_then: Market leader in process mining per Gartner Peer Insights coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: On device capture across apps with redaction, then turning observations into reliable playbooks and agents, is hard for two people. Deployment modes including on premises add load.

defensibility.rationale: Captured playbooks could create lock in over time, but at founding the product is new and well funded task mining vendors and AI agent startups can add similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to know. As of the batch these vendors already sold task mining.

market_need_then: Enterprises are adopting AI agents and need documented procedures for them to follow. Gartner still tracks task mining as its own market in 2026, which indicates existing spend.

branding.domain_note: Uses godhands.ai as of 2026; purchase history not found.

identity.logo: Simple mark beside a wordmark per site
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, short punchy headlines, security specifics for buyers

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable name but the company is weeks old with no brand press found beyond directories and one Fondo post.

outcome_analysis: GodHands joined YC in the Fall 2026 batch with two technical founders from a high frequency trading firm and is too young for an outcome. The product targets a market with established task mining vendors, so differentiation will rest on turning captured work into runnable agents and on security deployment options.
